name: trenitalia-commute
description: Books free abbonamento / Carta Tutto Treno seat reservations on lefrecce.it for a daily two-leg commute described in a personal config file.

interface.shortDescription: Free abbonamento seat reservations on lefrecce.it
interface.longDescription: Checks the workstation, reads the account's trips, finds the configured train type in each leg's time window, and books missing days at €0.00 only through the site's own pages (Playwright with installed Chrome or Edge). Personal data and the browser profile stay in ~/.trenitalia-commute; Windows credentials are encrypted for the local user.
defaultPrompt: Use $trenitalia-commute to show which commute days are booked.
Use $trenitalia-commute to book the commute days my account is still missing.
Use $trenitalia-commute to reserve the next two days.
